verses.uthmani: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبٗا
verses.indopak: قُلْ اُوْحِىَ اِلَىَّ اَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوْۤا اِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْاٰنًاعَجَبًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: ﻿qul oohiya ilayya annahu istama'a nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna sami'na quranan 'ajaban
verses.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened ˹to the Quran,˺ and said ˹to their fellow jinn˺: ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say, O Muhammad (s), to people: ‘It has been revealed to me, that is to say, I have been informed by way of revelation from God, exalted be He, that (annahu: the [suffixed] pronoun is that of the matter) a company of the jinn, the jinn of Nasībīn. This was at the time of the morning prayer at Batn Nakhla, a location between Mecca and Tā’if — these [jinn] being those mentioned in God’s saying, And when We sent a company of jinn your way…’ [Q. 46:29] — listened, to my recitation, then said, to their people upon returning to them: “We have indeed heard a marvellous Qur'an, whose clarity, the richness of its meanings and other aspects one marvels at,
verses.romanUrdu: Aey Nabi, kaho, meri taraf wahee (revelation) bheji gayi hai ke Jinno ke ek giroh (group) ne gaur se suna phir (jaa kar apne qaum ke logon se) kaha: “humne ek bada hi ajeeb Quran suna hai

verses.uthmani: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدٗا
verses.indopak: يَّهْدِىْۤ اِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَاٰمَنَّا بِهٖ ۗ وَلَنْ نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَاۤ اَحَدًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan
verses.saheeh: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
verses.khattab: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿which guides to rectitude, to faith and propriety. Therefore we believe in it and we will never, after this day, associate anyone with our Lord.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo raah-e-raast ki taraf rehnumayi karta hai is liye hum uspar iman le aaye hain aur ab hum hargiz apne Rubb ke saath kisi ko sharik nahin karenge

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةٗ وَلَا وَلَدٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّهٗ تَعٰلٰى جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَّلَا وَلَدًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waannahu ta'ala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan
verses.saheeh: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
verses.khattab: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And [we believe] that (annahu: the pronoun in this and in the next two instances is that of the matter) — exalted be the majesty of our Lord, transcendent is His majesty and magnificence above what is ascribed to Him — He has taken neither spouse nor son.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke hamare Rubb ki shaan bahut aala-o-Arfa hai , usne kisi ko biwi ya beta nahin banaya

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطٗا
verses.indopak: وَّ اَنَّهٗ كَانَ يَقُوْلُ سَفِيْهُنَا عَلَى اللّٰهِ شَطَطًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna 'ala allahi shatatan
verses.saheeh: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.
verses.khattab: and that the foolish of us used to utter ˹outrageous˺ falsehoods about Allah
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And that the fool among us, the ignorant one among us, used to utter atrocious lies against God, extreme calumny by attributing to Him a spouse and a son.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke hamare nadaan log Allah ke barey mein bahut khilaf-e-haqq baatein karte rahey hain

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّاۤ اَنْ لَّنْ تَقُوْلَ الْاِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu 'ala allahi kathiban
verses.saheeh: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.
verses.khattab: We certainly thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about Allah
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And we thought that (an: softened, that is to say, annahu) humans and jinn would never utter a lie against God, by attributing such things to Him, until we discovered their mendacity thereby. God, exalted be He, says:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke humne samjha tha ke insaan aur jinn kabhi khuda ke baarey mein jhoot nahin bol sakte

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْاِنْسِ يَعُوْذُوْنَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوْهُمْ رَهَقًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi ya'oothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan
verses.saheeh: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.
verses.khattab: And some men used to seek refuge with some jinn—so they increased each other in wickedness
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And that certain individuals of mankind used to seek the protection of certain individuals of the jinn, when they stopped over in dangerous places during their journeys — whereat every man would say, ‘I seek the protection of the lord of this place against the evil of the insolent ones in it’ — so that they increased them, by their seeking their protection, in oppressiveness, such that they would say, ‘We are now lords of jinn and humans!’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke Insano mein se kuch log Jinno mein se kuch logon ki panaah (refuge) maanga karte thay, is tarah unhon ne Jinno ka guroor aur zyada badha diya

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوْا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ اَنْ لَّنْ يَّبْعَثَ اللّٰهُ اَحَدًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yab'atha allahu ahadan
verses.saheeh: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
verses.khattab: And those ˹humans˺ thought, just like you ˹jinn˺, that Allah would not resurrect anyone ˹for judgment˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they, namely, the jinn, thought just as you, O humans, thought, that (an: softened in place of the hardened form, that is to say, annahu) God would never raise anyone, after his death.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke insaano ne bhi wahi gumaan kiya jaisa tumhara gumaan tha ke Allah kisi ko Rasool bana kar na bhejega

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسٗا شَدِيدٗا وَشُهُبٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاۤءَ فَوَجَدْنٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيْدًا وَّشُهُبًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban
verses.saheeh: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
verses.khattab: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The jinn say: And we made for the heaven, we desired to listen by stealth, but we found it filled with mighty guards, from among the angels, and meteors, scorching stars: this was at the time of the sending of the Prophet (s).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke humne aasman ko tatola to dekha ke woh pehray-daaron (terrible guards) se patha pada hai aur shahabon (shooting meteors) ki baarish ho rahi hai

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابٗا رَّصَدٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۗ فَمَنْ يَّسْتَمِعِ الْاٰنَ يَجِدْ لَهٗ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waanna kunna naq'udu minha maqa'ida lilssam'i faman yastami'i alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan
verses.saheeh: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
verses.khattab: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And we used to, that is to say, before his Mission, sit in [certain] places therein to listen in; but anyone listening now will find a meteor lying in wait for him, aimed at him, ready to strike him.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke pehle hum sun-gun lene ke liye aasman mei baithnay ki jagah paa lete thay, magar ab jo chori chupey sunne ke koshish karta hai woh apne liye ghaat mein ek shahabe saaqib (shooting meteors) laga hua paata hai

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىْۤ اَشَرٌّ اُرِيْدَ بِمَنْ فِى الْاَرْضِ اَمْ اَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan
verses.saheeh: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
verses.khattab: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And we do not know, by not being able to eavesdrop by stealth, whether ill is intended for those who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intends for them good.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke hamari samajh mein na aata tha ke aaya zameen walon ke saath koi bura maamla karne ka irada kiya gaya hai ya unka Rubb unhein raah-e-raast dikhana chahta hai

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الصّٰلِحُوْنَ وَمِنَّا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَ ۗ كُنَّا طَرَاۤٮِٕقَ قِدَدًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan
verses.saheeh: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
verses.khattab: Among us are those who are righteous and those who are less so. We have been of different factions
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And that among us some have become righteous, after having listened to the Qur'an, and some of us are otherwise, that is to say, a folk who are unrighteous; we are [made up of] different sects, opposing groups, [some] submitters to God and [others] disbelievers.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke hum mein se kuch log saleh (upright) hain aur kuch is se farotar hain, hum mukhtalif tareeqon (ways/factions) mein batey (divided) huey hain

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّاۤ اَنْ لَّنْ نُّعْجِزَ اللّٰهَ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَنْ نُّعْجِزَهٗ هَرَبًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: wanna thananna an lan nu'jiza allaha fee alardi walan nu'jizahu haraban
verses.saheeh: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
verses.khattab: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And we assume that (an: softened in place of the hardened form, that is to say, annahu) we will never be able to elude God in the earth, nor will we be able to elude Him by fleeing — we will not be able to escape Him, whether we are on earth or, fleeing from it, in the heavens.
verses.romanUrdu: Auy yeh ke hum samajhte thay ke na zameen mein hum Allah ko aajiz (frustrate) kar sakte hain aur na bhaag kar usey hara saktey hain

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسٗا وَلَا رَهَقٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدٰۤى اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ ۗ فَمَنْ يُّؤْمِنْ بِۢرَبِّهٖ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَّلَا رَهَقًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waanna lamma sami'na alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan
verses.saheeh: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
verses.khattab: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And that when we heard the guidance, the Qur'an, we believed in it. For whoever believes in his Lord (read an implied huwa, ‘he’, [before fa-lā yakhāfu]) shall fear neither loss, a diminishing of his good deeds, nor oppression, [nor] injustice, by having his evil deeds increased.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke humne jab hidayat ki taleem suni to hum uspar iman le aaye ab jo koi bhi apne Rubb par iman le aayega usey kisi haq-talfi ya zulm ka khauff na hoga

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُوْنَ وَمِنَّا الْقٰسِطُوْنَ ۗ فَمَنْ اَسْلَمَ فَاُولٰۤٮِٕكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا
verses.transliteration: waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan
verses.saheeh: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
verses.khattab: And among us are those who have submitted ˹to Allah˺ and those who are deviant. So ˹as for˺ those who submitted, it is they who have attained Right Guidance
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And that among us some have submitted [to God], while some of us are unjust, tyrants — on account of their disbelief. So whoever has submitted [to God], those are the ones who seek right guidance.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke hum mein se kuch muslim(Allah ke itaat guzar) hain aur kuch haqq se munharif (upright) to jinhon ne Islam (itaat ka raasta) ikhtiyar kar liya unhon ne najaat ki raah dhoond li

verses.uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبٗا
verses.indopak: وَاَمَّا الْقٰسِطُوْنَ فَكَانُوْا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban
verses.saheeh: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
verses.khattab: And as for the deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And as for those are unjust, they will be firewood, fuel, for Hell!” ’ (annā, annahum, and annahu totalling all twelve instances [above], including innahu ta‘ālā and annā minnā’l-muslimūna and what comes in between them may be read with a kasra [sc. innā, innahum etc.] indicating a new sentence [every time], or with a fatha [sc. annā, annahum etc.] indicating the statement that will follow [as a relative clause]).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jo haqq se muhnarif hai woh jahannum ka indhan (fuel) banney wala hai

verses.uthmani: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنْ لَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوْا عَلَى الطَّرِيْقَةِ لَاَسْقَيْنٰهُمْ مَّاۤءً غَدَقًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waallawi istaqamoo 'ala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan
verses.saheeh: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
verses.khattab: Had the deniers followed the Right Way, We would have certainly granted them abundant rain to drink—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says [the following] about the Meccan disbelievers: And [it has been revealed to me] that if they (allaw: softened in place of the hardened form, its subject having been omitted, that is to say, annahum [law], which is a supplement to annahu istama‘a, ‘that [a company of jinn] listened’) adopt the [right] path, the path of submission [to God], We will give them abundant water to drink, plenteous [water], from the heaven — this was after rain had been withheld from them for seven years —
verses.romanUrdu: Aur (aey Nabi kaho mujhpar yeh wahee bhi ki gayi hai ke) log agar raah-e-raast par sabit qadami (firmly) se chalte to hum unhein khoob sairaab karte (provide abundant rain)

wbw.translation: surely We (would) have given them to drink

verses.uthmani: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابٗا صَعَدٗا
verses.indopak: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيْهِ ۗ وَمَنْ يُّعْرِضْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهٖ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: linaftinahum feehi waman yu'rid 'an thikri rabbihi yaslukhu 'athaban sa'adan
verses.saheeh: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
verses.khattab: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿so that We may try them, test them, therein, and so know, through knowledge outwardly manifested, the nature of their gratitude. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, [from] the Qur'an, We will admit him (naslukhu, or read [first person] yaslukhu, ‘He will admit him’) into a tortuous chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Taa-ke is niyamat se unki aazmaish karein aur jo apne Rubb ke zikr se mooh modega uska Rubb usey sakht azaab mein mubtala kardega

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّ الْمَسٰجِدَ لِلّٰهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوْا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: waanna almasajida lillahi fala tad'oo ma'a allahi ahadan
verses.saheeh: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.
verses.khattab: The places of worship are ˹only˺ for Allah, so do not invoke anyone besides Him
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And [it has been revealed to me] that the places of prayer belong to God, so do not invoke, in them, anyone along with God, by associating others with Him, like the Jews and Christians do, who, when they enter their churches and temples, they ascribe partners to God.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke masjidein Allah ke liye hai, lihaza unmein Allah ke saath kisi aur ko na pukaro

verses.uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدٗا
verses.indopak: وَّاَنَّهٗ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللّٰهِ يَدْعُوْهُ كَادُوْا يَكُوْنُوْنَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا ۗ
verses.transliteration: waannahu lamma qama 'abdu allahi yad'oohu kadoo yakoonoona 'alayhi libadan
verses.saheeh: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
verses.khattab: Yet when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him ˹alone˺, the pagans almost swarmed over him
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And that (annahu; or innahu as a new sentence, the pronoun being that of the matter) when the servant of God, the Prophet Muhammad (s), rose to invoke Him, to worship Him, at Batn Nakhla, they, that is, the jinn listening to his recitation, were almost upon him in heaps (libadan or lubadan, the plural of libda [or lubda], like felt in the way they were heaped on top of one another, crowding in their eagerness to listen to the Qur'an).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke jab Allah ka banda usko pukarne ke liye khada hua to log uspar toot padne ke liye tayyar ho gaye

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدٗا
verses.indopak: قُلْ اِنَّمَاۤ اَدْعُوْا رَبِّىْ وَلَاۤ اُشْرِكُ بِهٖۤ اَحَدًا
verses.transliteration: qul innama ad'oo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan
verses.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He said, in response to the disbelievers saying, ‘Abandon this affair of yours!’ (a variant reading [for qāla, ‘he said’], has qul, ‘Say:’) ‘I invoke only my Lord, as God, and I do not associate anyone with Him’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aey Nabi ,kaho ke main to apne Rubb ko pukarta hoon aur uske saath kisi ko sharik nahin karta

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا رَشَدٗا
verses.indopak: قُلْ اِنِّىْ لَاۤ اَمْلِكُ لَـكُمْ ضَرًّا وَّلَا رَشَدًا
verses.transliteration: qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan
verses.saheeh: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
verses.khattab: Say, “It is not in my power to harm or benefit you.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘I truly have no power to bring you any harm, to lead [you] astray, or any guidance’, any good.
verses.romanUrdu: Kaho main tum logon keliye na kisi nuksan ka ikhtiyar rakhta hoon na kisi bhalayi ka

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٞ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا
verses.indopak: قُلْ اِنِّىْ لَنْ يُّجِيْرَنِىْ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدٌ ۙ وَّلَنْ اَجِدَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مُلْتَحَدًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: qul innee lan yujeeranee mina allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan
verses.saheeh: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
verses.khattab: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah ˹if I were to disobey Him˺, nor can I find any refuge other than Him
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘Indeed none shall protect me from God, from His chastisement, were I to disobey Him, and I shall never find besides Him, that is, other than Him, any refuge.
verses.romanUrdu: Kaho mujhey Allah ki giraft se koi nahin bacha sakta aur na main uske daaman ke siwa koi jaye panaah (refuge) paa sakta hoon

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا بَلَٰغٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
verses.indopak: اِلَّا بَلٰغًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَرِسٰلٰتِهٖ ۗ وَمَنْ يَّعْصِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَاۤ اَبَدًا ۗ
verses.transliteration: illa balaghan mina allahi warisalatihi waman ya'si allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan
verses.saheeh: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
verses.khattab: ˹My duty is˺ only to convey ˹the truth˺ from Allah and ˹deliver˺ His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there for ever and ever
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[I have power to bring you] only a communication (illā balāghan is excepted from the direct object clause of amliku, ‘I have power [to bring]’, that is to say, I have power only to communicate [the Message] to you, from God, that is, on His behalf, and His Messages (wa-risālātihi is a supplement to balāghan, ‘a communication’; what comes between the excepted clause and the clause from which it is excepted is a parenthetical statement intended to emphasise the preclusion of [the Prophet’s] ‘ability [to bring them anything else]’). And whoever disobeys God and His Messenger, concerning the affirmation of [His] Oneness, and hence does not believe — indeed there will be for him the fire of Hell, abiding (khālidīna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the person indicated by man, ‘whoever’, in lahu, ‘for him’, taking into account its [plural] import; it [khālidīna] is also an implied circumstantial qualifier, in other words, they shall enter it with their abiding having been preordained) therein forever’.
verses.romanUrdu: Mera kaam iske siwa kuch nahin hai ke Allah ki baat aur uske paighamaat pahuncha doon. Ab jo bhi Allah aur uske Rasool ki baat na maanega uske liye jahannum ki aag hai aur aisey log usmein hamesha rahenge

verses.uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرٗا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدٗا
verses.indopak: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا رَاَوْا مَا يُوْعَدُوْنَ فَسَيَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ اَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَّاَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
verses.transliteration: hatta itha raaw ma yoo'adoona fasaya'lamoona man ad'afu nasiran waaqallu 'adadan
verses.saheeh: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
verses.khattab: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Such that when they see (hattā is for inceptiveness, [but] also entailing a purposive sense to an implied preceding clause, that is to say, they persist in their disbelief until they come to see …) what they are promised, of chastisement, they will then know, at the moment that it befalls them, [either] on the day of Badr or on the Day of Resurrection, who is weaker in supporters and fewer in numbers, in assistants: is it them or the believers — according to the former [reading]? Or, is it Me or them, according to the latter. Some of them said, ‘When will this promise be [fulfilled]?’, whereupon the following was revealed:
verses.romanUrdu: (Yeh log apni is rawish se baaz na aayenge) yahan tak ke jab us cheez ko dekh lenge jiska inse waada kiya ja raha hai to inhein maloom ho jayega ke kiske madadgaar kamzoar hain aur kiska jattha (group) taadad mein kam hai

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبٞ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا
verses.indopak: قُلْ اِنْ اَدْرِىْۤ اَقَرِيْبٌ مَّا تُوْعَدُوْنَ اَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهٗ رَبِّىْۤ اَمَدًا
verses.transliteration: qul in adree aqareebun ma too'adoona am yaj'alu lahu rabbee amadan
verses.saheeh: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
verses.khattab: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘I do not know if what you are promised, of chastisement, is near, or if my Lord has set a [distant] length for it, an extent and a term which only He knows.
verses.romanUrdu: Kaho, main nahin jaanta ke jis cheez ka waada tumse kiya ja raha hai woh qareeb hai ya mera Rubb uske liye koi lambi muddat muqarrar famata hai

verses.uthmani: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verses.indopak: عٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلٰى غَيْبِهٖۤ اَحَدًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: 'alimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru 'ala ghaybihi ahadan
verses.saheeh: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
verses.khattab: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the unseen, disclosing none of it to anyone
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Knower [He is] of the Unseen, what is hidden from servants, and He does not disclose, He [does not] reveal, His Unseen to anyone, from mankind,
verses.romanUrdu: Woh aalimul gaib hai , apne gaib par kisi ko muttala (reveal/disclose) nahin karta

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٖ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدٗا
verses.indopak: اِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضٰى مِنْ رَّسُوْلٍ فَاِنَّهٗ يَسْلُكُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهٖ رَصَدًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan
verses.saheeh: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
verses.khattab: except messengers of His choice. Then He appoints angel-guards before and behind them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except to a messenger of whom He approves. Then, in addition to disclosing to him what He will [to disclose] of it, by way of [making it] a miracle for him, He despatches, He appoints and sends forth, before him, namely, the Messenger, and behind him watchers, angels to preserve him until He has conveyed [it] to him as part of the [entire] revelation,
verses.romanUrdu: Siwai us Rasool ke jisey usne (gaib ka koi ilm dene ke liye) pasand karliya ho, to uske aagey aur pichey woh muhafiz (guards) laga deta hai

verses.uthmani: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا
verses.indopak: لِّيَـعْلَمَ اَنْ قَدْ اَبْلَغُوْا رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَاَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَاَحْصٰى كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًا
verses.transliteration: liya'lama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin 'adadan
verses.saheeh: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
verses.khattab: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿so that He, God, may know, by knowledge outwardly manifested, that (an: softened in place of the hardened form, that is to say, annahu) they, that is, the messengers, have conveyed the Messages of their Lord (the plural person [of the verb ablaghū, ‘they have conveyed’] takes into account [the plural] implication of man, ‘whom’), and He encompasses all that is with them (wa-ahāta bimā ladayhim is a supplement to an implied clause, that is to say: so He has knowledge of that) and keeps count of all things’ (‘adadan, ‘count’, is for specification; it is transformed from a direct object [sc. ‘adada], originally: ahsā ‘adada kulli shay’in, ‘He keeps count of all things’).
verses.romanUrdu: Taa-ke woh jaan le ke unhon ne apne Rubb ke paighamaat pahuncha diye, aur woh unke poorey maahol ka ihata (encompass) kiye huey hai aur ek ek cheez ko usne gin rakkha hai
